newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Prop offers flats at HK$7,750/sq ft.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop offers flats at HK$7,750/sq ft.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd said on Wednesday it would offer 48 flats in the first sales batch from its Royal Sea Crest residential development in Tsing Lung Tau in the New Territories at HK$7,750 a square foot.
Royal Sea Crest comprises 168 units of sizes ranging from 1,275 to 1,299 square feet, in two 21-storey blocks. The property is scheduled for handover in February 1998, it said.
Public registration for potential buyers will be from April 28 to 30.
The company said 85 percent of the units would be allocated to individuals and 15 percent would be made available to buyers registering using company names.

Last month, the Hong Kong government announced new regulations allowing developers to put unfinished flats on the market earlier than before in a bid to increase supply and cool down escalating property prices.
Private flats can now be put up for sale 15 months before they are ready instead of 12 months previously.
Developers also have to put the flats on the market within six months of the government granting approval for sales and to release no less than 20 percent of the total in every batch.
